value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: turns food ingredients into packaged confections for wholesalers and retailers

geography_served.value: global: primarily the United States, Canada and Mexico, with exports to other markets

specialization.value: related lines: chewy candies, lollipops, mints and chewing gum
